description: The regional health agency inventories gamma cameras, SPECT equipment and PET scanners for nuclear-medicine diagnosis and therapy. The two native component descriptions name commissioning date, technology type, healthcare organisation, hospital, coordinates, clinical unit and financing method. The survey derives from the Ministry NSIS GR.AP. equipment flow through December 2024. An intended 2025 update is mentioned but not confirmed. A linked explanatory PDF and map were not read. Coverage is Puglia, Italy. Native metadata declares CC-BY-4.0. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. The gamma-camera/SPECT and PET components share the same agency, December 2024 NSIS GR.AP. survey, equipment attributes. Their document and map labels match, but their URLs differ. They are grouped as one equipment inventory; source identities remain distinct and overlapping rows are not assumed equal.
